title: Hearty Dense Korean Cherry Banchan
description: A savory and dense Korean side dish featuring marinated cherries, perfect for adventurous eaters, this vegetarian-friendly banchan is a unique twist on traditional Korean cuisine.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, blend gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the blended marinade and sesame oil.
Add the dried cherries to the marinade and toss to coat.
Let the cherries marinate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove the cherries from the marinade and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the cherries for 20 minutes or until they are tender and slightly caramelized.
In a small bowl, mix together the toasted sesame seeds and chopped scallions.
Sprinkle the sesame seed and scallion mixture over the baked cherries.
Serve the Hearty Dense Korean Cherry Banchan warm or at room temperature.
